drafts.en:
Health Functional FoodNiacin 5mgManganese 0.9mgVitamin B1 1.2mgVitamin B2 1.5mgVitamin B6 1.5mgVitamin E 6mgSelenium 30μgZinc 3mgPantothenic acid 5mgOnce a day

비타챔피언Niacin · Manganese · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)알피바이오 · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 5mg of Niacin, 0.9mg of Manganese, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 1.5mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 6mg of Vitamin E, 30μg of Selenium, 3mg of Zinc, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 5mg Niacin, 0.9mg Manganese, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 1.5mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 6mg Vitamin E, 30μg Selenium, 3mg Zinc, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)알피바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (5mg / 15g), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (0.9mg / 15g), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 15g), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.5mg / 15g), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 15g), 80~150%
Vitamin E labelled (6mg / 15g), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (30μg / 15g), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (3mg / 15g), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 15g), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 노랑색의 스틱형 젤리
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 18개월
Storage 직사광선 및 고온다습한 곳을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. 소비 중 흡습되지 않도록 포장의 파손 등에 주의하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Manganese · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
